+Iteration: `r2_numeric` (round 2), parent `r1_contract`. Gate: full val (n=40, 38 paired), paired, k_se 1.0, `--gate-against control`, concurrency 8, 1 trial. **Outcome: REJECTED on the gate** (`verdict_stable: true` → booked as a reject, not inconclusive).
+## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks, biggest first)

+All 9 val failures surviving r1_contract were re-read individually. Round 1 had moved every one of them upstream: each now writes a well-formed file, under the right sheet name, with near-correct coverage. So the clusters below are all *reading/interpretation*, not output mechanics.
+| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause (verified in trace, not guessed) | tag | change class |

+| 1 | FORMULA-TEXT READ — `data_only` never used | 3/9 (53647 + 2) | `ws[a1].value` returns the formula STRING; every number derived from it is poisoned. Hard evidence: the token `data_only` appears **0 times** across all r1_contract rollouts, and 0 of the 3 formula-confused tasks tried it | KNOWLEDGE | prompt.md new §3: two-load recipe |

+| 2 | VERIFICATION IS A PRESENCE CHECK | ~4/9 | r1's EMPTY/CHANGED recipe prints the expected SHAPE on a wrong answer — 41978 printed `EMPTY: 0 []` / `CHANGED: 10` while being the round's only regression | BEHAVIORAL | prompt.md §5: RECONCILE half |

+| 3 | FORMAT CLAUSE vs INLINE EXAMPLE | 1/9 (49036) | agent calls the instruction "ambiguous" and copies the example `67%` over the explicit `.00 decimal` clause; gold is `66.67% WIN RATE` | KNOWLEDGE | prompt.md §4 bullet |

+| 4 | CRITERIA-VALUE NORMALIZATION | 1/9 (41978, r1's regression) | matches on the type/case it assumes rather than the values present (`int(y)==2015` vs the sheet's own `COUNTIF(...,"2015")` on text) | KNOWLEDGE | prompt.md §3 normalize-both-sides |
+| 5 | `''` vs `None` | 1/9 (5835) | treats an empty-string cell as a failed lookup and patches around its own failing check | KNOWLEDGE | prompt.md §3 bullet |

+| cluster | edit class | file | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |

Generalizes: it is a property of openpyxl, independent of task content | yes — adds a read, changes no arithmetic; a task with no formulas sees identical values from both loads |

+| 4 | print-then-compare step | prompt.md §3 | print the DISTINCT `(repr, type)` of any column you filter on, then compare both sides normalized; `2014 == '2014'` is False | yes — normalizing both sides cannot un-match a pair that already matched exactly |

+- Cluster 1: grepped all r1_contract rollouts for `data_only` → 0 hits; confirmed 53647 read `'=SUM(...)'` as a value. The fix is exercised iff `data_only` appears in r2 traces. **Post-hoc: it does** — 33722's own turn-2 block loads `wsv = load_workbook(IN, data_only=True)`. The rule fired; the round still did not pay.
+- Cluster 3: computed gold for 49036 from the golden workbook (`66.67% WIN RATE`) vs the agent's `67% WIN RATE`. **Post-hoc: 49036 is the round's one genuine fix vs both controls.**
+- Cluster 2: re-read 41978's clean-printing CHECK on a wrong answer; designed RECONCILE to need a value the agent did not produce.

+- Blast radius, checked before spending: no passing task saves the `data_only` workbook, and the two-load change adds a read rather than altering a write. +`0.8462` vs controls `0.8421` / `0.7949`. `gate_delta 0.0`, threshold `0.0533`, `verdict: reject`, `verdict_stable: true`. Regressions `[33722, 46646]`; FIXED vs both controls `[49036]`, BROKE vs both controls `[33722]` — net zero. `56427` unpaired (`sandbox exec failed: 500 Server Error`).

+**`parent_vs_gate_ref_drift = +0.0671`** — the parent's stored 0.775 re-measured as 0.842. The screen, which pairs against stored parent rewards, therefore claimed Δ̄ +0.30 and `fixed: [38985, 41978, 49036]`; the concurrent control shows most of that was drift. Screen Δ̄ is not evidence; only `--gate-against control` is.

+**33722's regression, root-caused:** gold is a row-anchored shrinking window `MEDIAN(FILTER(B{r}:$B$12, ...))`; r2 filtered to the 3 matching rows and then dropped `matches[offset:]`, which coincides for E2:E4 and exhausts the data at E5:E6. +- task_template.md's `to_excel`/`ExcelWriter` prohibition with its four concrete consequences.
+- "preview row `i` is Excel row `i+2`, pandas column `j` is Excel column `j+1`".
+- The CHECK recipe's literal-A1 addressing, the EMPTY/CHANGED sets, the explicit FINISH condition, and "never re-send an identical block".
+- The two-load `data_only` recipe: it is mechanically correct and was exercised. Its failure to pay is not evidence against it.
+- The format-clause-beats-example rule: the round's one genuine fix.
+## Deliberately skipped
+- Anything aimed at 341-40 or 535-20 (not prompt-space; see the excluded row above).
+- Editing the adapter, grader, harness, benchmark or environment — out of bounds.
+- Any rule mentioning a task id, a specific cell address from a real task, or a gold value.
+- Growing trials on this candidate: `verdict_stable: true` with `gate_delta 0.0` means growth cannot rescue a zero delta, so this is a reject rather than an inconclusive.

-  integer"), that requirement holds even when an inline example looks rounded. Satisfy both: match
-  the example's wording AND the stated precision.
+- **A format clause governs the digits; an inline example only shows the layout.** When the
+  instruction states a rendering ("with .00 decimal", "nine decimal places", "two decimals", "as a
+  percentage") and also shows an example whose digits disagree with it, the clause wins and the
